notes: Shelf 'Coats' rebuilt: 9 kinds (all old kinds kept), 33 archetypes, 30 brands, 5 traditions. Dropped from old data: Acronym J1L-GT (brief: belongs to Shell jacket — for that worker, not this shelf); unverifiable/wholesale product names (Arwa, Maskit Desert Coat, Manheimer Berliner Mantel, Bouguessa, POTRENDS, Coulange, Margn, Valley Apparel, Sheltersuit Foundation charity item, Discovery Expedition, Joutsen Blenda/Knut, Jack Murphy Erin/Malvern) as SKU noise; Canada Goose list cut to Expedition/Chilliwack/Langford per brief. Chesterfield, Polo coat, Covert coat, Inverness cape, Bisht, Burnous are maker-free archetypes (Brooks Brothers / Polo RL polo-coat versions not confirmed on a retrieved page, so left out). Years not confirmed on retrieved pages (Canada Goose Expedition 1982, Norma Kamali 1973, Max Mara Manuela) are left blank; MoMA dates the Sleeping Bag Coat to the 1970s. Burberry fit descriptions kept neutral (retrieved page only names Chelsea/Kensington/Waterloo/Camden). Shuba kept as alias only (no page retrieved). Puffer 'm' list uses OutdoorGearLab award winners (Fjällräven Nuuk, OR Coze, Rab Neutrino Pro, REI Stormhenge, Patagonia Jackson Glacier) plus market-covering brands; Which?/CR lists not retrieved. Basotho blanket named designs (old maker-less models) became versions of one archetype under Cape with a tradition entry.
